subject: Math
subskill: Read Value from Graph or Table
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The bar graph shows the number of books checked out from a library on each of four days. How many more books were checked out on Thursday than on Tuesday?
explanation: Choice A is correct. The bar representing Thursday has a height of $75$, so $75$ books were checked out on Thursday. The bar representing Tuesday has a height of $60$, so $60$ books were checked out on Tuesday. Therefore, $75 - 60$, or $15$ more books were checked out on Thursday than on Tuesday.
